comments.text: Hello and welcome to the Philippines! 🇵🇭 Here, the Metro Manila minimum wage is 19,630 pesos a month, about three hundred and twelve dollars, while a modest one-bedroom flat outside the centre can ask 17,660 pesos before a single light is switched on. From a fourteen-peso jeepney ride and a plate of adobo to the money sent home from abroad, this film stacks every bill onto one paycheck to see how the month really works.
